user.title: DORALAB Notifications
user.description: Sets up the central notification list. Push recipients per notification type are configured afterwards in the settings overview.

abort.single_instance_allowed: The notification center is already set up.

data.dismiss_imported: Dismiss imported HA notifications in HA
data.excluded_notify_services: Devices that should not receive push notifications
data.push_icon: Default icon for push notifications (path or URL, empty = off)
data.push_icon_force: Use the default icon even for types with their own image

error.invalid_push_icon: Enter a path such as /local/logo.png or an http(s) URL.

send.name: Send notification
send.description: Creates a notification in the center (or updates it via its tag) and pushes it according to the type settings.

type.name: Type
type.description: Identifier of the notification type, e.g. paket_zugestellt. Unknown types are created automatically.

title.name: Title
title.description: Defaults to the name of the type.

tag.name: Tag
tag.description: The same tag updates the existing notification instead of creating a new one.

link.name: Link
link.description: Dashboard path that opens when the notification is tapped.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: Overrides the icon of the type.

push.name: Send push
push.description: Turn off to only fill the center.

category.name: Category
category.description: Only used when a new type is created automatically.

type_name.name: Type name
type_name.description: Only used when a new type is created automatically.

type_icon.name: Type icon
type_icon.description: Icon of the type: mdi:name, a path like /local/logo.png, a web address or data:image/…. Only for automatically created types, empty = category icon.

once.name: Only once
once.description: The tag is reported only a single time, even after the notification was deleted (e.g. new calendar events).

baseline.name: Remember only
baseline.description: With "Only once": only remember the tag as seen, without notification or push (silent first run).

read.name: Read
read.description: Turn off to mark as unread.

tags.name: Tags
tags.description: List of tags; deletes all notifications with these tags.

set_type.name: Configure type
set_type.description: Sets the push recipients and mode of a notification type.

recipients.name: Recipients
recipients.description: List of person entities, e.g. ["person.alice"]. An empty list means no push.

push_when.name: Push mode
push_when.description: always = always, away = only to persons who are not at home.
